text_blocks.snippet: Military severance pay is a one-time lump-sum payment calculated using the formula: Years of Active Service × 2 × Monthly Basic Pay. The minimum creditable service used in this equation is 3 years, while the maximum is capped at 19 years. Defense Finance Accounting Service (DFAS) (.mil)
snippet_highlighted_words: Years of Active Service × 2 × Monthly Basic Pay

text_blocks.snippet: To calculate your exact severance pay, you will need:

list.snippet: Years of Active Service: Total years of service including inactive duty points for reserves.
Monthly Basic Pay: Your current monthly base pay corresponding to your rank and time in service. Defense Finance Accounting Service (DFAS) (.mil)

text_blocks.snippet: Access the official DoD calculators to determine your specific separation or disability severance pay:

list.snippet: Disability Separations: Use the Medical Final Pay Calculator provided by MyArmyBenefits for public or CAC-authorized estimates.
Involuntary Separation Pay (Non-Disability): View full eligibility rules and calculation formulas on the Involuntary Separation Pay page maintained by the Defense Department.
General Compensation: Check your base pay figures on the Military Pay Calculator hosted by Military.com to ensure accurate inputs. MyArmyBenefits (.mil) +2
